int_name: E WILLOW GROVE AVE & WYNDMOOR ST

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a sidewalk on one side of a residential street but lacks any marked crossings or traffic control infrastructure. Parked vehicles along the curb create significant visual obstructions for pedestrians attempting to cross the roadway.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb block visibility between pedestrians on the sidewalk and oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left curb line where the white van and red truck are parked.

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or curb ramps are provided to facilitate safe street crossing.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: A large asphalt patch or pothole in the center of the travel lane could cause vehicle swerving.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the road in the foreground.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to designate a safe crossing point and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility by moving pedestrians past the line of parked cars.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the damaged pavement to ensure a smooth and predictable surface for all road users.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a lack of formal crossing infrastructure at a wide, unmarked intersection. Sightlines are partially obstructed by a bridge structure and mature vegetation, creating potential conflicts between vehicles and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks at this intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross a wide, unmarked roadway without designated priority.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: The bridge abutment on the left and dense trees on the right limit visibility for both drivers and pedestrians approaching the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side under the bridge and right side along the tree line

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian paths and alert drivers to the crossing location.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve the visibility of pedestrians waiting to cross.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install warning signs to alert drivers of the potential presence of pedestrians at the intersection.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a sidewalk and a stop sign but lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals. While the low-traffic residential setting provides some inherent safety, the absence of basic crossing infrastructure and tactile warnings on curb ramps creates risks for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to indicate a pedestrian crossing area at the intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of Tactile Warnings
hazards.description: The curb ramp lacks truncated domes or tactile paving, making it difficult for visually impaired pedestrians to identify the edge of the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Bottom left corner at the curb ramp

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Large trees and shadows at the corner may obscure pedestrians from the view of turning motorists.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile warning pads (truncated domes) on existing curb ramps to improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Manage vegetation and restrict parking near the intersection to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
